item.shootingstar.chitty.tooltip.1: Use on the ground or water to put her down; use her to get in (into the seat you click).
item.shootingstar.chitty.tooltip.2: G: wings, then jump at speed to fly; sprint to dive. She floats by herself.
key.shootingstar.chitty_wings: Chitty: open or fold the wings
hud.shootingstar.chitty.road: Drive and steer · %s: rev · %s: wings, then jump at speed to fly · %s: eject the back seat · %s: horn
hud.shootingstar.chitty.stalled: She didn't catch · %s to swing the handle again
hud.shootingstar.chitty.air: Jump: climb · Sprint: dive · %s: fold the wings · %s: eject the back seat · %s: horn
subtitles.shootingstar.chitty.start: Chitty starts: chitty chitty bang bang
advancements.shootingstar.chitty_fly.des: Spread Chitty's wings and take to the air
advancements.shootingstar.chitty_float.d: Drive Chitty into the water and float away
item.shootingstar.airship.tooltip.0: Baron Bomburst's airship · stands eight, lifts six
item.shootingstar.airship.tooltip.1: Use on the ground to put her down; use her to board. Walk to the wheel in the bow to fly her; sneak to get off
item.shootingstar.airship.tooltip.2: R: grapple · K: rope ladder · B: drop a bomb (load them by using bombs on her) · O: overboard
key.shootingstar.airship_grapple: Airship: let the grapple down (hold); with it in hand on the ground, throw it
key.shootingstar.airship_ladder: Airship: let down or draw up the rope ladder
hud.shootingstar.airship.ladder_off: Letting the ladder down: keep sneaking to climb down onto it
hud.shootingstar.airship.grabbed: Caught on the grapple! Hold sneak to struggle free
hud.shootingstar.airship.free: You wrench yourself free of the grapple!
hud.shootingstar.airship.holding: You have the grapple · %1$s: throw it · use it on someone close to hook them · jump to hang on · sneak to let go
hud.shootingstar.airship.hanging: Hanging on the grapple · lean to swing · jump to climb the rope · sneak to let go
hud.shootingstar.airship.yanked: The grapple is pulled out of your hands
hud.shootingstar.airship.ui.title: Airship
hud.shootingstar.airship.ui.wheel: Walk to the wheel in the bow to fly her
hud.shootingstar.airship.ui.heavy: Too heavy: she lifts %s, and is sinking
hud.shootingstar.airship.ui.wound_in_hin: If the crew wind it in, up you go with it
hud.shootingstar.airship.ui.wound_up: The crew are winding you up to her
hud.shootingstar.airship.ui.let_down: The crew are letting you down
hud.shootingstar.airship.ui.leap_on: Leap and catch it to swing
advancements.shootingstar.airship_root.d: Get hold of Baron Bomburst's airship
advancements.shootingstar.airship_grab.d: Seize something with the airship's grapple
advancements.shootingstar.airship_bomb.d: Drop a bomb from the airship
item.shootingstar.carriage.tooltip.0: A cage on wheels, with a fast black horse
item.shootingstar.carriage.tooltip.1: Use her door to open or shut it; lead or shove things in while it is open
item.shootingstar.carriage.tooltip.2: Driving: jump cracks the whip · J dresses her as a trader's wagon, with a counter for bait
key.shootingstar.carriage_disguise: Carriage: put up or take down the trader's-wagon disguise (standing)
hud.shootingstar.carriage.wont_fit: That won't fit in the cage
hud.shootingstar.carriage.still_caught: You are still locked in the cage
hud.shootingstar.carriage.disguise_stop: Stop the horse to put the disguise up or down

hud.shootingstar.carriage.trapped: It's a trap! The door slams shut behind you
